basic_details.job_title: Shillong Medical College Medical Social Worker Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Shillong Medical College has announced 1 vacancy for the Medical Social Worker post on a contract basis. Candidates can apply offline by submitting their applications in the prescribed format along with self-attested copies of all relevant certificates and testimonials to The O/o THE DIRECTOR, SHILLONG MEDICAL COLLEGE on or before 19 October 2026 at 17:00 hrs. Applicants must possess a Master's Degree in Social Work (MSW) from a recognized University/Institution. The notified remuneration for the post is Rs. 60,000 per month. The selection process consists of shortlisting based on educational

age_limit.details: Candidates should preferably be not more than 35 years of age as on the last date of submission of application. Relaxation in the upper age limit may be considered as per applicable Government norms.

qualification.details: Master's Degree in Social Work (MSW) from a recognized University/Institution. Experience: Candidates having experience of 1-2 years in a hospital/healthcare setting, particularly in patient counselling, psychosocial support, rehabilitation or community-based programmes, shall be preferred. Skills: The candidate should possess good communication and interpersonal skills and be able to work effectively with patients, attendants, doctors, nurses and other healthcare professionals. Knowledge of computer applications and basic documentation/record-keeping shall be desirable. Language: The candidate should be able to communicate effectively in English. Knowledge of Khasi is MANDATORY and/or other local languages shall be an added advantage. | Candidates should preferably be not more than 35 years of age as on the last date of submission of application. Relaxation in the upper age limit may be considered as per applicable Government norms.

selection_process: Eligible candidates shall be shortlisted based on their educational qualifications and relevant experience. Shortlisted candidates may be called for a personal interview/interaction before the duly constituted Selection Committee. The decision of the Selection Committee/competent authority regarding selection shall be final.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Interested candidates must submit their applications in the prescribed format along with self-attested copies of all relevant certificates and testimonials to the following address: The O/o THE DIRECTOR, SHILLONG MEDICAL COLLEGE, Pasteur Hills, Lawmali Road, Shillong, Meghalaya – 793001 Applications must reach the office on or before 19 October 2026 at 17:00 HRS.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Master's Degree in Social Work (MSW) from a recognized University/Institution. Experience: Candidates having experience of 1-2 years in a hospital/healthcare setting, particularly in patient counselling, psychosocial support, rehabilitation or community-based programmes, shall be preferred. Skills: The candidate should possess good communication and interpersonal skills and be able to work effectively with patients, attendants, doctors, nurses and other healthcare professionals. Knowledge of computer applications and basic documentation/record-keeping shall be desirable. Language: The candidate should be able to communicate effectively in English. Knowledge of Khasi is MANDATORY and/or other local languages shall be an added advantage. Candidates should preferably be not more than 35 years of age as on the last date of submission of application. Relaxation in the upper age limit may be considered as per applicable Government norms.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of educational qualification certificates Experience certificate Caste certificate (if applicable) Other relevant testimonials and certificates No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the concerned employer, if currently employed in any Government/Private organisation

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates shall be shortlisted based on their educational qualifications and relevant experience. Shortlisted candidates may be called for a personal interview/interaction before the duly constituted Selection Committee. The decision of the Selection Committee/competent authority regarding selection shall be final.

faq.question: Q1. Is the Medical Social Worker post permanent or contractual?
faq.answer: The engagement is purely temporary and contractual in nature for an initial period of one year, or as may be decided by the competent authority, and shall not confer any right for regular appointment under the Government of Meghalaya.

faq.question: Q2. What is the upper age limit and is any age relaxation provided?
faq.answer: Candidates should preferably be not more than 35 years of age as on the last date of submission of application. Relaxation in the upper age limit may be considered as per applicable Government norms.

faq.question: Q3. How are candidates shortlisted for the interview?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates are shortlisted based on their educational qualifications and relevant experience, and shortlisted candidates may be called for a personal interview or interaction before the Selection Committee.

faq.question: Q4. What language proficiency is mandatory for this post?
faq.answer: The candidate should be able to communicate effectively in English, and knowledge of Khasi is mandatory and/or other local languages shall be an added advantage.
